title: Ares Capital Corporation 8-K Filing — 2026-04-28
summary: Ares Capital Corporation (ARCC), a business development company, entered into new equity distribution agreements with five sales agents (Truist, Mizuho, RBC, Regions, SMBC) on April 28, 2026, establishing an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering program with an aggregate offering price of up to $1.5 billion. The company simultaneously terminated prior equity distribution agreements from February 2025 that had been in effect with four of the same agents. The company has no obligation to sell any shares under the new agreements.
key_points: Ares Capital entered into new equity distribution agreements with Truist, Mizuho, RBC, Regions, and SMBC on April 28, 2026
The ATM program allows issuance of common stock with aggregate offering price up to $1.5 billion
Sales may be made 'at the market' per Rule 415(a)(4), including on NASDAQ Global Select Market
Sales agents receive commissions of up to 1.5% of gross sales price
The company has no obligation to sell any shares and may suspend the program at any time
Prior equity distribution agreements from February 2025 were terminated and superseded
why_it_matters: This is a routine corporate securities filing for a single BDC's equity shelf program. It has no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts. While ATM programs can theoretically cause equity dilution, the company has no obligation to issue shares and actual sales will depend on market conditions and the company's capital needs. This does not constitute a macro market event.
